rows=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
rows[25]['crop_ok']='n';rows[25]['errors']=['crop_clipped'];rows[25]['owner_crop']['text_ne_visible_line']='yes';rows[25]['owner_crop']['turned_or_clipped']='yes';rows[25]['segmentation_detail']='The lower descender feet of Д meet and are cut by the bottom boundary.'

assert len(rows)==len(cards)==56
assert [r['card_id'] for r in rows]==[r['card_id'] for r in cards]

 assert set(r['owner_crop'].values())<= {'yes','no','uncertain'}

print('Count and order verified:',len(rows))
for k in ['letters','marks','crop_ok']:print(k,dict(collections.Counter(r[k] for r in rows)))
